tools.portfolio.description: Your own account: cash, debt, quantity and average cost of each position, current market value and unrealised P/L, total wealth and return, credit limit, margin-call line, interest paid, recent equity curve and forced-liquidation records.
tools.pool.description: Dynamic stock pool: the current tradable list, the next IPO (name/sector/issue price/listing round) and the delisting-warning list (symbol plus review round). New listings and delistings are announced publicly in advance.
tools.market.description: Current quotes for every symbol: last price, previous close, change, ma5/ma10/ma20, momentum, realised volatility, ten levels of book depth, borrowable shares, delisting review round, plus the published news for each symbol (market flash / company wire / earnings / corporate event, with cash-flow change percent and personality shift) and the public earnings calendar (next_report_round and that day's report_tick). The stock pool is dynamic: api.call("stock:market","pool") returns the current list, the next IPO and the delisting warnings.
tools.day_report.description: Execution receipt for the previous trading day: your orders broken down by status (filled / partially filled then expired / cancelled), fill count, shares and amounts bought and sold, and fees. Use it to check whether the strategy actually executed as intended.
tools.round.description: Round calendar and window quotas: which round it is, whether today is a trading or a closed day, rounds until the next open, the shared tick, and the used/limit quota of trading moments and pre-open planning actions.
tools.script.description: Trading-script slot. write saves source; patch replaces one exact spot; both are auto-checked and return the verdict. read returns your current source for free; status returns the last execution result; slot is 1-4 or research. Automatic trading slots run only on trading days, never on closed days. Define def on_tick(): to be called back once per sleep interval; state is a separate persistent JSON dict. The sandbox is a Python subset: no f-string, lambda, set, try, class or import; sort with a named def passed as key=, join strings with +. api.call("stock:clock","sleep",ticks=N) only schedules the next callback — the callback must return, never busy-wait with while. run only executes an unlocked research slot for analysis and backtests, read-only, and cannot place orders. On trading days scripts run automatically along the 20000 shared ticks after every player has ended the round; orders take effect at the earliest on the next tick and fills are visible immediately.
tools.script.parameters.properties.actio: write: save the source (auto-checked). patch: replace one exact spot. status: last execution result. read: read your current source for free. run: execute the research slot (read-only, cannot trade).
tools.script.parameters.properties.sourc: Full source of the restricted-Python strategy.
tools.script.parameters.properties.old.d: Exact snippet to replace; it must occur exactly once in the saved source.
Slot id: 1-4 for automatic trading slots, or research.
tools.script.parameters.properties.inclu: true returns the saved source together with the status.
tools.bank.description: Bank: action=borrow to borrow, repay to repay. Borrowing accrues interest every round-end and increases the risk of forced liquidation.
borrow: draw cash, debt rises, interest is charged at every round end, limited by the credit line. repay: pay cash first, then reduce debt, never beyond cash or debt.
tools.compute.description: Rent compute with in-game cash: action=buy or release, kind=pool or slot. It is valid for this round only and must be re-bought next round. The research slot is charged per use and needs no purchase.
tools.compute.parameters.properties.acti: buy: add one tier of compute pool (kind=pool) or one trading slot (kind=slot), charged immediately, valid this round only. release: give one tier back; no refund today, usage is not reset, saved source is kept.
tools.compute_status.description: This account's compute pool, trading slots, shared quota usage, research runs used and remaining, and the price of every tier.
tools.intel.description: Commercial intelligence: action=steal obtains a snapshot of another player's cash, bank loan and position sizes; action=source steals a random fragment of their strategy source. target is a public player id; each is charged at the published price.
tools.intel.parameters.properties.action: steal: pay the snapshot price for another player's cash, loan and position sizes (not refreshed automatically). source: pay the higher price to steal at most six consecutive lines of their saved strategy source, with slot, revision and line range.
tools.intel_status.description: The public player list, the snapshot and source-steal prices, and the reports you already bought, with their acquisition time.
tools.end_turn.description: End this round's actions and submit a one-line summary (what you did this round, what you plan next). Settlement happens only after every player has ended.
stock.b.closed: Round {round}{total}, market closed today ({days} rounds until the next open){tail}: no trading, but you can still edit scripts, plan and borrow.
stock.b.left: , {left} rounds left (the final round settles automatically)
stock.b.planning: Pre-open planning actions {used}/{limit}; shared market timeline {tick}/{slices} ticks. Trading slots run automatically after every player ends their actions on trading days and never on closed days; on_tick callbacks wake every 100 ticks by default and state persists across days. The research slot is charged per run: 200 cash each, read-only and only while you are acting.
stock.b.compute: Compute pool tier {pool}, trading slots {slots} (reset every round — re-buy if you need them); remaining this round {steps} units / {calls} API calls; research runs left {research}; compute fees paid so far {fees}.
stock.b.bankrupt: You have gone bankrupt and were delisted in round {round}; you take no further actions.
stock.b.account: Cash {cash}, debt {debt}, holdings value {holdings}, total wealth {wealth} ({return_pct}%). Credit limit {credit}, margin-call line {margin}.
stock.b.risk_frozen: Risk control frozen — you may only reduce positions and repay: {notice}
stock.b.forced_close: Bank forced liquidation: sold {quantity} shares of {symbol} in round {round}, recovered {amount}.
stock.b.quotes_head: Quotes (symbol name last change ma5 ma10 volatility earnings calendar latest news):
stock.b.pool_listing: IPO {name}({symbol},{sector}) lists in round {round} at an issue price of {anchor}
stock.b.pool_warning: {symbol} is under a delisting warning, reviewed in round {round}
stock.b.day_report: Execution receipt for the previous trading day (round {round}): {orders} orders ({statuses}), {fills} fills, bought {bought_qty} shares / {bought_amt}, sold {sold_qty} shares / {sold_amt}, fees {fees}. Partially filled then expired means the order was not fully filled; expired means it was cancelled at the close.
stock.b.script_result: Last script run (round {period}): {status}, {steps} steps, {calls} API calls, {actions} actions.
stock.b.script_never: The script has not run yet: the engine executes it at the end of a trading round and reports back at the start of the next round.
stock.b.other_slot: Slot {slot} last run (round {period}): {status}, {steps} steps, {calls} API calls.
stock.b.intel: Snapshot price {price}, source-fragment price {code_price}, reports bought {count}.

stock.b.intel_snapshot: round {round}/tick{tick} {name}: cash {cash}, loans {debt}, long {long}, short {short} (snapshot at acquisition).
